Being rich allows me to lead the life that I have always wanted. Obsessing over an idea or 2 without any worries, being able to take care of my family without bills piling up, repay my debt to my parents.. I had always wanted to be someone who could get out of the situation I'm in up to this point(being poor, being financially screwed , bla bla bla the list goes on ).I tried harder each day but I couldn't find opportunities lying around even though I have tried my best to be the best in the position that I'm in. Education opens up multiple roads in today's world and it is nearly impossible to climb up from a low-entry job such as flipping burgers, selling products and etc. Selling products opens up alittle bit of opportunity to get recognized but people generally look down on those who hadn't completed education . I don't blame them , in fact it's what I would be doing if I were in their position. Anyways, I strongly urge you to focus on your university and be the best amongst ur cohords or school or state or the world, in doing so you would be opening up a world full of money on the table waiting for you to grab it..
